SELECT DISTINCT history_actions.source_key, history_actions.subject_type, history_actions.change_type, history_actions.action_code FROM ( SELECT 'AUTHORIZATION_HISTORY' AS source_key, h.subject_type, h.change_type, NULL AS action_code FROM t_authorization_history h
UNION ALL SELECT 'OPERATION_LOG', NULL, NULL, l.action_code FROM t_operation_log l
UNION ALL SELECT 'USER_LIFECYCLE_EVENT', NULL, NULL, CONCAT('USER_', event.action) FROM t_user_lifecycle_event event
) history_actions ORDER BY history_actions.source_key, history_actions.subject_type, history_actions.change_type, history_actions.action_code
